question: Where can I get the planned new power lines and substations in Germany, with location, voltage, planned date and status?

answer.summary: Germany has separate transmission and distribution plans. BNetzA's Monitoring_gdb FeatureServer maps 183 BBPlG/EnLAG transmission sections (Luftlinie, Korridorverlauf, Trassenverlauf). Project sheets and NEP 2037/2045 PDFs add commissioning dates and 871 substation measures. BSH's FEP 2025 WFS/GeoJSON maps offshore platforms and cables. For distribution, 95 of 814 VNBdigital operators have an active plan service. The 2026 XLSX examples checked lack coordinates.
main_caveats: BNetzA and NEP cover transmission. 95 of 814 VNBdigital listings have an active distribution plan service. The exemption for operators below 100,000 customers has an exception for qualifying curtailment under § 14d(8) EnWG.

Substations lack unified official GIS: BNetzA maps 205 unattributed nodes (Vorhabenpunkte) and embeds HVDC converters in line sheets, while NEP's 871 substation Punktmaßnahmen and DSO Umspannwerke are published without coordinates.

Corridor vs route geometry: BNetzA's Monitoring_gdb mixes straight-line node pairs (Luftlinie, 34), federal corridors (Korridorverlauf, 13) and concrete/approved routes (Trassenverlauf, 136); always filter by Typ and Vorhabenst.

Missing dates and voltages in GIS: BNetzA Monitoring_gdb omits commissioning dates (shown on netzausbau.de HTML sheets and NEP PDFs) and sets Spannung='unbekannt' on 23/157 BBPlG features; BSH FEP GeoJSON omits voltage and year.

VNBdigital 2026 XLSX traps: DSO spreadsheets lack coordinates, encode start/commissioning months as Excel serial integers, report voltage tiers (HS, UW HS auf MS, MS, NS) not kV, and some DSOs (e.g. Netze BW) anonymize asset names.
answer.confidence_reason: Directly queried BNetzA ArcGIS FeatureServers, BSH FEP 2025 GeoJSON/WFS, VNBdigital GraphQL and 2026 DSO XLSX tables, NEP 2037/2045 PDFs, ENTSO-E TYNDP 2026 JSON API, OpenStreetMap Overpass, and EnWG §§ 12b, 14d–14e statutory texts.

attributes.note: Exact GIS lines/polygons for BBPlG/EnLAG transmission (corridor vs route) and BSH offshore platforms/cables; NEP substations and VNBdigital DSO plans give names/regions only.
attributes.gap_note: No official coordinates are published for NEP's 871 onshore substation Punktmaßnahmen or VNBdigital's § 14d EnWG distribution measures (PDF raster maps and substation/region names only, with some DSOs such as Netze BW anonymizing measure names); DSOs under 100,000 customers without >3% curtailment are exempt under § 14d Abs. 8 EnWG.

attributes.note: BNetzA GIS/HTML and NEP PDFs report kV (including AC/DC hybrids and 380/110-kV transformers); VNBdigital XLSX gives tier codes (HS, UW HS auf MS, MS, NS); OSM uses Volts.
attributes.gap_note: 23 of 157 BNetzA Vorhaben_BBPlG GIS features state Spannung='unbekannt' (and 1 null), BSH FEP 2025 GeoJSON/WFS and TYNDP 2026 preliminary API omit voltage fields, and VNBdigital XLSX standardizes voltage tiers (HS, MS, NS) rather than kV except in unstandardized prose descriptions.

attributes.note: NEP Projektsteckbriefe, netzausbau.de HTML project sheets and TYNDP give target commissioning years; VNBdigital 2026 XLSX gives expected start and commissioning month/year.
attributes.gap_note: Commissioning dates are absent from BNetzA's Monitoring_gdb ArcGIS FeatureServer, BSH's FEP 2025 GeoJSON/WFS, and NEP's 871-row Punktmaßnahmen substation PDF (which flags only Startnetz vs 2037/2045 scenarios); OSM carries date tags on only 4 of 436 features, and exempt small DSOs publish no § 14d EnWG tables.

attributes.note: BNetzA GIS tracks 6 permitting/construction stages per section; VNBdigital XLSX gives both Projektstatus and permitting stage per DSO asset; TYNDP gives 4 status classes.
attributes.gap_note: NEP's Punktmaßnahmen table distinguishes Startnetz from Zubaunetz without permitting or construction phases. BSH FEP 2025 assigns status='planned' to wind areas and sites. The VNBdigital directory does not establish which operators outside the active plan service publish status tables elsewhere.

attributes.note: BNetzA GIS edited 2026-10-08 (Q2/2026 cut-off, HTML sheets to 2026-11-25); VNBdigital NAP 2026 drafts 2026-10-31; NEP V2025 2nd Draft 2026-03/08; BSH FEP 2025-01-30; TYNDP 2026.
NEP archives biennial plans from 2012 to 2025; BNetzA archives quarterly PDF reports (2013–2026); VNBdigital keeps 2024 PDFs and 2026 XLSX/PDFs; BSH archives FEP 2019–2025.
attributes.gap_note: BNetzA's Monitoring_gdb FeatureServer overwrites geometries in place without historical GIS snapshots, distribution Netzausbaupläne under § 14d EnWG began only in 2024 (no pre-2024 series, and 2024 was PDF-only whereas 2026 added XLSX), and NEP project/measure IDs split or renumber across cycles.

attributes.note: Quarterly BNetzA monitoring (plus continuous web updates); biennial NEP (§ 12b EnWG), DSO NAP by 31 Oct (§ 14d EnWG) and TYNDP; statutory BSH FEP updates; continuous OSM edits.

sources.name: Netzausbau Monitoring_gdb, Vorhabenpunkte & Projektsteckbriefe (netzausbau.de)
sources.format: ArcGIS FeatureServer (JSON / GeoJSON) + HTML project sheets & PDF quarterly reports
sources.license: Copyright Bundesnetzagentur / 50Hertz, Amprion, TenneT, TransnetBW (no open-data license stated)
sources.adds: Authoritative GIS polylines (corridors vs concrete/approved routes), voltage and permitting/construction phase for statutory BBPlG and EnLAG transmission projects, paired with HTML project sheets giving target commissioning years.
sources.summary: Official ArcGIS REST FeatureServer behind netzausbau.de mapping statutory BBPlG and EnLAG transmission projects by permitting section, paired with HTML project sheets.
sources.coverage_note: 183 polyline section features (157 BBPlG across 106 statutory projects; 26 EnLAG across 22 projects), of which 138 are planned/in permitting/under construction/completed and 45 already in operation; plus 205 connection nodes in Vorhabenpunkte and 135 HTML project sheets.
caveats: Omits planned commissioning dates in GIS (fetch 'Gesamtinbetriebnahme' from netzausbau.de HTML project sheets) and marks Spannung='unbekannt' on 23/157 BBPlG features.
Covers extra-high-voltage transmission lines only; substations/converters are not standalone attributed GIS records, and Typ mixes Luftlinie (34), Korridorverlauf (13) and Trassenverlauf (136).

coverage.geographic: Germany nationwide (onshore extra-high-voltage transmission grid and statutory cross-border/offshore grid links under BBPlG and EnLAG)

unit.value: Polyline permitting/monitoring sections (Abschnitte) in Vorhaben_BBPlG (157 features across 106 unique Vorhabennu) and Vorhaben_EnLAG (26 features across 22 unique Vorhabennu); companion Vorhabenpunkte has 205 connection points.
unit.quote: Mit der Genehmigung einer Leitung (Planfeststellungs­beschluss) wird der genaue Verlauf einer Leitung fest­gelegt und der zuständige Netzbetreiber darf mit den Bau­maßnahmen beginnen.

inclusion_rule.value: Statutory extra-high-voltage transmission projects enacted by federal parliament in the Bundesbedarfsplangesetz (BBPlG) and Energieleitungsausbaugesetz (EnLAG).
inclusion_rule.quote: Übersichtskarte: Vorhaben aus dem BBPlG und dem EnLAG

reference_date.value: ArcGIS FeatureServer last edited 2026-10-08 (matching Q2/2026 Monitoring cut-off); individual HTML Vorhaben pages updated continuously (e.g. 2026-11-25 on BBPlG 03).

update_frequency.value: Quarterly monitoring releases from BNetzA's internal DANA database, with continuous HTML updates on netzausbau.de as permitting decisions occur.
update_frequency.quote: Die Bundes­netz­agentur aktualisiert die Übersicht kontinuierlich.

exclusions.value: Excludes 110 kV and MV/LV distribution grids, pre-statutory NEP candidate projects not yet in BBPlG, and standalone substations/transformers (HVDC converters appear only as sub-sections of line projects such as BBPlG 05 Abschnitt D3b).
exclusions.quote: Insgesamt beläuft sich der Bedarf beim Netzausbau auf rund 16.900 km Höchst­spannungs­leitungen.

key_fields.meaning: Statutory project identifier (e.g. 'BBPlG 03', 'EnLAG 07') and endpoint route name.
Spatial precision of the geometry: 'Luftlinie' (straight-line node pair), 'Korridorverlauf' (spatial/federal corridor under ROV/Bundesfachplanung), or 'Trassenverlauf' (concrete/approved route).
Section status: not in permitting, in ROV/Bundesfachplanung, before/in Planfeststellungsverfahren, approved or under construction, completed, or in operation.
Voltage ('380 kV', '525 kV', '320 kV', '320 bis 525 kV', or 'unbekannt'), AC vs DC technology, and overhead ('Freileitung') vs underground ('Erdkabel').
Responsible TSO(s), permitting authority ('Bundesnetzagentur' vs 'Landesbehörden'), and slug linking to https://www.netzausbau.de/Vorhaben/ansicht/de.html for 'Gesamtinbetriebnahme'.

steps: Query Layer 0 (Vorhaben_BBPlG, 157 features) and Layer 1 (Vorhaben_EnLAG, 26 features) with outSR=4326&f=geojson or f=json; maxRecordCount is 2000 so each layer fits in a single request.
Filter out already operational sections via Vorhabenst <> 'Abschnitt in Betrieb' (removes 28 BBPlG and 17 EnLAG sections) to isolate planned, permitting, under-construction and newly built sections.
Separate geometry stages via Typ: 'Trassenverlauf' (concrete/plan-approved alignment), 'Korridorverlauf' (500–1,000 m federal corridor), and 'Luftlinie' (schematic straight line).

Join connection nodes from .../Vorhabenpunkte/FeatureServer/0 (205 points) and fetch expected commissioning year ('Gesamtinbetriebnahme') from https://www.netzausbau.de/Vorhaben/ansicht/de.html?nummer=<N>&gruppe=bbplg.
reading_traps: Monitoring_gdb omits planned commissioning dates ('Gesamtinbetriebnahme'); those appear only on each project's HTML Steckbrief (e.g. 'geplant für 2028' on BBPlG 03) and in the 191 MB quarterly Monitoringbericht PDF.
23 of 157 Vorhaben_BBPlG features have Spannung='unbekannt' and 1 has null; cross-check the HTML Steckbrief or NEP Projektsteckbriefe for voltage.
Features include operational history ('Abschnitt in Betrieb': 28 BBPlG, 17 EnLAG); failing to filter Vorhabenst overcounts planned lines.

Substations and HVDC converters are not separate features in Monitoring_gdb; Vorhabenpunkte/FeatureServer/0 gives only Name and StartEnd ('ja'/'nein') without voltage or status, while converters appear as line sub-sections (e.g. BBPlG 05 'Konverterbereich Isar (Abschnitt D3b)').

evidence.claim: netzausbau.de interactive map loads public ArcGIS FeatureLayers for BBPlG (Layer 0), EnLAG (Layer 1), offshore Anbindungsleitungen, and Vorhabenpunkte.
HTML project sheet for BBPlG 03 (SuedLink) provides HVDC voltage (525 kV), capacity (2 GW) and planned commissioning year (2028) missing from the GIS table.
evidence.quote: technische Daten Gleichstrom (2 GW) | 525 kV ... Gesamtinbetriebnahme geplant für 2028

evidence.claim: BNetzA's underlying DANA database is login-restricted to TSOs, permitting authorities, BMWE and BNetzA.
evidence.quote: Die Web­anwendung ist für die Übertragungs­netz­betreiber, die Genehmigungs­behörden, das Bundes­wirtschafts­ministerium sowie die Bundes­netz­agentur zugänglich.

sources.name: VNBdigital — Netzausbaupläne der Verteilernetzbetreiber (§§ 14d, 14e EnWG)
sources.format: GraphQL JSON index + operator XLSX spreadsheets (Maßnahmenplan & kompakt) and PDF reports
sources.license: Operator-specific: mostly unstated/all rights reserved; some operators apply CC BY 4.0 to XLSX (e.g. Bayernwerk Netz GmbH) and CC BY-ND 4.0 to PDF
sources.adds: Indexes individual distribution network plans. VNBdigital lists 95 operators with an active plan service. Checked examples include 2026 XLSX measure tables and PDF reports.
sources.summary: Statutory § 14e EnWG joint portal where obligated electricity DSOs publish biennial § 14d EnWG distribution expansion plans as standardized 2026 XLSX measure spreadsheets and 2024/2026 PDFs.
sources.coverage_note: Of 814 DSOs in the GraphQL directory, 95 have an active plan service ('nap'). Example XLSX downloads contained 1,205 measure rows at Bayernwerk Netz, 15,097 at Westnetz and 18,094 at Netze BW.
caveats: No geographic coordinates are published (substation/line names or anonymized regional labels only; grid maps are static images in PDFs without existing-grid topology).
Exempts DSOs under 100,000 customers unless renewable curtailment exceeded 3% (§ 14d Abs. 8 EnWG); XLSX dates are Excel serial numbers and include completed/cancelled rows.

coverage.geographic: Germany nationwide across 6 statutory planning regions (Nord, Ost, West, Mitte, Südwest, Bayern), covering 95 activated DSOs out of 814 listed electricity DSOs

unit.value: One row per planned, ongoing, completed or cancelled distribution grid measure (line or substation) in each DSO's 'Maßnahmenplan' XLSX (e.g. 1,205 rows in Bayernwerk Netz, 15,097 in Westnetz, 18,094 in Netze BW; >33,000 nationwide).
unit.quote: Alle Maßnahmen die innerhalb der nächsten 5 Jahre (NS-MS) bzw. 10 Jahre (Umspannung HS/MS und HS) aus Sicht der Netzplanung begonnen werden müssten.

inclusion_rule.value: Mandatory under § 14d Abs. 1 & 8 EnWG for electricity DSOs with >= 100,000 directly or indirectly connected customers, or smaller DSOs that curtailed >3% of onshore wind/solar generation in each of the two preceding years.
inclusion_rule.quote: Die Absätze 1 bis 4 sowie 6 und 7 sind nicht anzuwenden auf Betreiber von Elektrizitätsverteilernetzen, an deren Elektrizitätsverteilernetz weniger als 100 000 Kunden unmittelbar oder mittelbar angeschlossen sind.

reference_date.value: Second-round NAP 2026 consultation drafts ('Entwurfsfassung' / 'DRAFT') published 2026-10-31 to 2026-11-02 alongside finalized 2024 plans ('FINAL').
reference_date.quote: Die Veröffentlichung auf der Internetseite „VNBdigital“ (https://vnbdigital.de) der deutschen Verteilnetzbetreiber erfolgte am 31. Oktober 2026.

update_frequency.value: Every two years by 31 October under § 14d Abs. 1 EnWG (initial cycle 2024; regular statutory cycle starting 31 October 2026, with post-consultation final versions).
update_frequency.quote: Betreiber von Elektrizitätsverteilernetzen haben der Regulierungsbehörde alle zwei Jahre jeweils zum 31. Oktober eines Kalenderjahres, beginnend mit dem Jahr 2026, einen Plan für ihr jeweiliges Elektrizitätsverteilernetz (Netzausbauplan) vorzulegen.

exclusions.value: Excludes ~719 smaller municipal/local DSOs (<100,000 customers and <=3% curtailment), omits geographic coordinates in the standardized VNBdigital Maßnahmenplan XLSX schema across tested operators, and omits existing-grid topology in PDF maps for critical-infrastructure protection.
exclusions.quote: Auf die Darstellung des Bestandnetzes wurde zum Schutz der kritischen Infrastruktur bewusst verzichtet.

key_fields.meaning: Asset name and technical scope (e.g. 'UW Kleinschwabhausen - Neubau Umspannwerk', 'Leitung Lüdinghausen-Abzw. Lippe'; anonymized as 'HS-Maßnahme'/'NAP Maßnahme' by some DSOs).

Category ('Neubau', 'Netzoptimierung und -verstärkung', 'Ersatz(neubau) mit Erhöhung der Übertragungskapazität') and asset codes (201 UW HöS/HS, 301 HS line, 401 UW HS/MS, 501 MS line, 601 UW MS/NS, 701 NS line).
Grid voltage tier: 'UW HöS auf HS', 'HS' (typically 110 kV), 'UW HS auf MS', 'MS', 'UW MS auf NS', or 'NS'.
Expected commissioning month/year (accompanied by optimal completion date [12/JJJJ] and expected construction start [MM/JJJJ]).
Project state ('vorgesehene Maßnahme', 'konkrete Planung', 'im Bau', 'abgeschlossen', 'weggefallene Maßnahme') and permitting status.

how_to_use.example_request: curl -sL -X POST 'https://www.vnbdigital.de/gateway/graphql' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"query":"query { vnb_gridExpansionDocumentsExternal(vnbId: \"1068\") { uploadDate url metadata { filename version } } }"}'
steps: POST to https://www.vnbdigital.de/gateway/graphql with query { vnb_vnbs { _id name services { activated type { type } } } } (do NOT request voltageTypes, which throws a server nullability error) and filter services where type.type=='nap' and activated==true (95 DSOs).

For each vnbId, query vnb_gridExpansionDocumentsExternal(vnbId) to obtain direct GET URLs (https://www.vnbdigital.de/gateway/files?serviceName=vnb&fileId=...) for 2026 'Maßnahmenplan' XLSX and PDF files.
In each 'Maßnahmenplan' sheet, read headers on row 2 or row 3 (varies by 1 row across operators; Westnetz also inserts an extra 'Kosten (geschätzt) in Euro' column S, shifting later columns by one).

Filter Projektkategorie and Projektstatus (exclude 'abgeschlossen', 'weggefallene Maßnahme', and pure 1:1 replacement 'Ersatz(neubau) ohne Erhöhung der Übertragungskapazität') and convert Excel date serials (epoch 1899-12-30) to YYYY-MM.
reading_traps: Do NOT include 'voltageTypes' in GraphQL vnb_vnbs queries: the gateway fails with 'Cannot return null for non-nullable field vnb_VNB.voltageTypes'.

No DSO spreadsheet contains geographic coordinates, and naming precision varies sharply: Bayernwerk and Westnetz name concrete substations/municipalities ('UW Kleinschwabhausen'), whereas Netze BW anonymizes all 18,094 rows to 'HS-Maßnahme' or 'NAP Maßnahme' with Teilnetzgebiet='Netze BW'.
Date columns store raw Excel serial numbers in XML (e.g. 46357 = 2026-12-01, 49644 = 2035-12-01, plus occasional typos like 72502 = year 2098 in Netze BW row 4).
Row counts include already completed ('abgeschlossen'), cancelled ('weggefallene Maßnahme') and pure 1:1 replacement rows alongside new build ('Neubau') and upgrades.

evidence.claim: § 14e EnWG mandates a joint internet platform operated by electricity DSOs, implemented at vnbdigital.de.
evidence.quote: Betreiber von Elektrizitätsverteilernetzen sind verpflichtet, ab dem 1. Januar 2023 zu den in den folgenden Absätzen genannten Zwecken eine gemeinsame Internetplattform einzurichten und zu betreiben.

sources.name: Netzentwicklungsplan Strom (NEP 2037/2045) — Digitale Projektbibliothek, Projektsteckbriefe & Punktmaßnahmen
sources.publisher: 50Hertz Transmission GmbH, Amprion GmbH, TenneT TSO GmbH, TransnetBW GmbH
sources.format: PDF reports/Steckbriefe + paginated HTML Digitale Projektbibliothek (static PNG maps; no GIS or XLSX measure list)
sources.license: All rights reserved (prior written consent of the TSOs required per Impressum)
sources.adds: Covers pre-statutory candidate transmission projects (Zubaunetz to 2045), expected commissioning windows per measure, archived plan editions since 2012, and 871 substation/transformer/switchgear point measures (Punktmaßnahmen) absent from BNetzA GIS.
sources.summary: Joint TSO statutory transmission plan (§ 12b EnWG) publishing candidate and confirmed projects through 2037/2045 as PDF Steckbriefe and a 40-page substation Punktmaßnahmen report.
sources.coverage_note: 871 unique substation/transformer/switchgear M-code point measures in the downloaded Punktmaßnahmen PDF, plus 272 onshore and offshore transmission projects in the NEP 2037/2045 (2025) 2nd Draft Digitale Projektbibliothek (and archived editions 2012–2023).
caveats: Published as PDFs and HTML pages with static PNG maps only (no CSV/XLSX measure list or GIS routes); copyright reserved by the 4 TSOs.
Punktmaßnahmen substation tables give scenario flags (Startnetz vs 2037/2045) rather than exact commissioning dates or coordinates.

coverage.geographic: Germany nationwide (onshore 220/380 kV AC and HVDC transmission plus offshore grid connection systems in North and Baltic Seas)

unit.value: 272 transmission projects (composed of individual line/station Maßnahmen M...) in the NEP 2037/2045 (2025) 2nd Draft Digitale Projektbibliothek, plus 871 unique M-code point measures in the 40-page Punktmaßnahmen companion PDF.
unit.quote: Neben Leitungsbaumaßnahmen sind im Netzentwicklungsplan Strom (NEP) auch Punktmaßnahmen für ein bedarfsgerechtes Stromnetz erforderlich.

inclusion_rule.value: All effective measures for demand-driven optimization, reinforcement and expansion of the German transmission network required through 2037/2045 under § 12b EnWG (both already confirmed Startnetz and proposed Zubaunetz).
inclusion_rule.quote: Der gemeinsame nationale Netzentwicklungsplan muss alle wirksamen Maßnahmen zur bedarfsgerechten Optimierung, Verstärkung und zum Ausbau des Netzes enthalten

reference_date.value: NEP 2037/2045 Version 2025, 2nd Draft (Punktmaßnahmen PDF published 2026-03-16; Sonderveröffentlichung Steckbriefe 2026-05-19; combined Steckbriefe PDF 2026-08-11), following BNetzA confirmation of NEP 2037/2045 (2023) in March 2024.
reference_date.quote: Begleitdokument zum Netzentwicklungsplan Strom 2037 mit Ausblick 2045, Version 2025, zweiter Entwurf

update_frequency.value: Biennial statutory cycle (1st draft, 2nd draft, BNetzA confirmation under §§ 12b–12c EnWG); next cycle NEP 2040/2045 (2027) scenario framework already initiated.
update_frequency.quote: Die Betreiber von Übertragungsnetzen mit Regelzonenverantwortung legen der Regulierungsbehörde auf der Grundlage des Szenariorahmens einen gemeinsamen nationalen Netzentwicklungsplan zur Bestätigung vor.

exclusions.value: Excludes distribution grids (<=110 kV except vertical 380/110-kV or 220/110-kV coupling transformers and 110-kV switchgear bays at transmission nodes); provides static PNG/PDF schematic maps rather than route coordinates.
exclusions.quote: Vertikale Punktmaßnahmen stellen eine Verbindung zwischen Übertragungs- (380 kV, 220 kV) und Verteilnetz (110 kV) her.

key_fields.meaning: NEP project code (e.g. 'TTG-P53', 'DC43', '50HzT-P364'), corresponding BBPlG statutory number ('BBP-Nr: 41'), and measure ID ('M54', 'M30TR_b', 'M748SA').

key_fields.field: Basisdaten (Startnetz / Zubaunetz, Onshore / Offshore, AC / DC)
key_fields.meaning: Distinguishes already confirmed baseline projects ('Startnetz') from scenario-dependent new proposals ('Zubaunetz' across scenarios A/B/C 2037 and 2045).
Classifies 'Leitung' vs 'Anlage' (reactive compensation/booster) or Punktmaßnahme ('380-kV-AC-Schaltanlage', '380/110-kV-Transformator', '380-kV-Einschleifung', 'Kundenanschluss').
Planned commissioning year or multi-year window per measure in Projektsteckbriefe (e.g. '2029 - 2032', '2032 - 2034', '2045').

Extract line measures, voltage, km, 'BBP-Nr' and 'Geplante Inbetriebnahme' from individual Projektsteckbriefe PDFs with pdftotext -layout.

Download NEP_2037_2045_V2025_2_Entwurf_Punktmassnahmen.pdf (40 pages) to obtain Tabelle 1 (Startnetz) and Tabelle 2 (Zubaunetz with A/B/C 2037 & 2045 scenario flags) covering 871 substation, switchgear, transformer and customer-connection point measures.
reading_traps: Horizontal point measures confirmed under § 12c EnWG (e.g. STATCOM, MSCDN, compensators) sit in Projektsteckbriefe, whereas vertical 380/110-kV transformers, switchgear bays and loop-ins not subject to § 12c confirmation sit only in the separate Punktmaßnahmen PDF.
Maps in the Digitale Projektbibliothek are static raster PNGs (/sites/default/files/project_library/maps/.../*.png), not downloadable GeoJSON.
Tabelle 1 in Punktmaßnahmen uses a two-column side-by-side page layout (pages 4–27); parse left and right column blocks separately when running pdftotext -layout.
Some Zubaunetz projects (e.g. DC43, DC44) carry an explicit economic-optimum caveat ('negatives Kosten-Nutzen-Verhältnis') and are not yet confirmed by BNetzA.

evidence.claim: Unconfirmed vertical/horizontal substation, transformer and switchgear measures are published in the companion Punktmaßnahmen document rather than main NEP Steckbriefe.
evidence.quote: Da die Bundesnetzagentur vertikale Punktmaßnahmen und zum Teil horizontale Punktmaßnahmen (Transformatoren, Schaltanlagen, Einschleifungen und Kundenanschlüsse) jedoch nicht nach § 12c EnWG bestätigt, sind diese im NEP 2037/2045 (2025) nicht als eigenständige Maßnahmen enthalten. ... Daher veröffentlichen die Übertragungsnetzbetreiber diese Maßnahmen dennoch in diesem Begleitdokument.

evidence.claim: Individual NEP Projektsteckbrief TTG-P53 (BBP-Nr 41) documents both a 380 kV replacement line (M54, commissioning 2032–2034) and new 380 kV switchgear/380-110 kV transformers.
evidence.quote: M54 Raitersaich/West - Suchraum Ludersheim/West ... Geplante Inbetriebnahme: 2032 - 2034 ... Hierzu ist eine 380-kV-Schaltanlage mit anfänglich zwei und langfristig vier 380/110-kV-Transformatoren in Suchraum Ludersheim/West (Suchraum Gemeinden Altdorf bei Nürnberg/ Winkelhaid) an Stelle der bestehenden 220-kV-Schaltanlage neu zu errichten (Netzausbau).

Planning state ('planned' on area/site layers) and provenance across FEP editions ('publishing': '20250130').

steps: Download the complete multi-layer JSON file (Site_Development_Plan_2025.json, 3.16 MB) or GeoPackage, or query individual layers via WFS 2.0.0 with srsName=EPSG:4326&outputFormat=application/json.

When parsing Site_Development_Plan_2025.json, iterate over the top-level dictionary keys ('converter_buffer', 'transformer_buffer', 'subseacable_buffer', 'gate') — each key holds its own GeoJSON FeatureCollection.
Cross-reference name_fep (e.g. 'NOR-3-2') with NEP Offshore Projektsteckbriefe or the FEP 2025 report text to attach DC voltage (typically 320 or 525 kV) and target commissioning year.
reading_traps: Site_Development_Plan_2025.json is NOT a single FeatureCollection: its root JSON object has 9 named keys, each containing a FeatureCollection (reading root['features'] returns nothing).
Bare root URL https://gdi.bsh.de/ returns HTTP 403 Forbidden; access the direct data/WFS endpoints or Geoportal.de metadata record.
Geometries represent buffer zones at 1:400,000 planning scale rather than exact engineering footprints, and omit voltage and commissioning year attributes.

evidence.claim: BSH WFS GetCapabilities authorizes reuse under Federal GeoNutzV with attribution '© BSH 2025' at 1:400,000 planning scale.

sources.adds: Openly licensed (ODbL) exact coordinates for both extra-high-voltage and 110 kV lines, cables and substations currently under construction or proposed in Germany.
sources.summary: Crowd-sourced ODbL vector dataset via Overpass API mapping under-construction and proposed power lines, cables and substations with exact coordinates.
sources.coverage_note: 436 OSM elements in Germany (401 construction=line, 21 construction=cable, 7 construction=substation, 4 proposed=line, 2 proposed=cable, 1 proposed=substation); individual ways represent segments/busbars rather than whole projects.
caveats: Captures mainly active construction sites (only 7 proposed elements and 8 substations nationwide) and lacks commissioning dates on 432 of 436 elements.
Voltages are in Volts ('220000' = 220 kV); overpass-api.de returned HTTP 406 to bare CLI clients, so use the maps.mail.ru Overpass mirror or set Accept headers.

coverage.geographic: Germany nationwide (crowd-sourced, concentrated on active construction sites)

unit.value: Individual OSM nodes, ways and relations (436 elements in Germany: 401 construction=line, 21 construction=cable, 7 construction=substation, 4 proposed=line, 2 proposed=cable, 1 proposed=substation); a single line project may be split into dozens of ways/busbars.

attempts.note: Counted live from Overpass response (436 OSM elements across DE admin_level=2); OSM elements represent mapped geometry segments rather than administrative projects.
Checked Overpass Turbo frontend; unit semantics follow standard OSM power=construction / power=proposed tagging.

inclusion_rule.value: Voluntarily mapped power infrastructure tagged power=proposed or power=construction with proposed/construction in (line, cable, minor_line, substation, converter).

attempts.note: Verified empirically via Overpass tag filter across ISO3166-1=DE.
No statutory inclusion rule applies to crowd-sourced OSM mapping.
Returned live OSM snapshot on 2026-11-25 (138,044 bytes).

exclusions.value: Severely under-represents pre-construction planned lines and substations (only 7 proposed elements and 8 substations total across Germany) and omits commissioning dates on 432 of 436 elements.

attempts.note: Verified by auditing all 436 returned DE elements: 429 construction vs 7 proposed; 406 carry voltage; only 4 carry start_date/opening_date/check_date.
Main overpass-api.de nginx returned HTTP 406 to default CLI requests without Accept/UA negotiation, while maps.mail.ru mirror succeeded with HTTP 200.

key_fields.meaning: Lifecycle prefix ('proposed' vs 'construction') and asset type ('line', 'cable', 'substation', 'converter').
Nominal voltage in Volts (e.g. '380000', '220000', '110000'; semicolon-delimited for multi-voltage lines), populated on 406 of 436 DE elements.
TSO/DSO name, line/substation name or code, and expected completion date (present on only 4 of 436 DE elements).

steps: POST the Overpass QL query to https://maps.mail.ru/osm/tools/overpass/api/interpreter (note: overpass-api.de returned HTTP 406 Not Acceptable to default bare curl/urllib requests).
Divide numeric voltage values by 1,000 to convert Volts to kV and split semicolon-separated multi-voltage strings (e.g. '380000;110000').
Exclude substation internal busbars (tags.line=='busbar') if counting inter-substation transmission/distribution circuits.
reading_traps: OSM stores voltage in Volts ('220000' = 220 kV), not kV.
Many construction=line ways represent short substation busbars (line=busbar) or individual span segments rather than whole projects.
Coverage is heavily skewed toward visible physical construction (429 construction vs 7 proposed; only 8 substations total) and 99% lack planned commissioning dates.

problems: Primary instance https://overpass-api.de/api/interpreter returned HTTP 406 Not Acceptable to default CLI headers; public mirror https://maps.mail.ru/osm/tools/overpass/api/interpreter served HTTP 200.

evidence.claim: Overpass returns 436 proposed or under-construction power line, cable and substation elements in Germany.

regulator.name: Bundesnetzagentur für Elektrizität, Gas, Telekommunikation, Post und Eisenbahnen (BNetzA)

operators.note: Four transmission system operators with control-area responsibility (50Hertz Transmission, Amprion, TenneT TSO, TransnetBW) operate the 220/380 kV AC and HVDC grid. VNBdigital lists 814 electricity DSOs, including 95 with an active plan service.

publication_obligation.what_must_be_published: 4 TSOs must submit a joint national Netzentwicklungsplan Strom (all effective optimization, reinforcement and expansion measures) for BNetzA confirmation (§§ 12b–12c EnWG); BSH publishes the offshore Flächenentwicklungsplan; DSOs >=100,000 customers (or >3% curtailment) must submit and publish Netzausbaupläne covering 5-year, 10-year and 2045 horizons with HV/MV grid maps, congestion regions, planned measures, permitting status and expected timeline on a joint platform (§§ 14d–14e EnWG).
publication_obligation.frequency: Every 2 years for NEP Strom (§ 12b EnWG) and every 2 years by 31 October for DSO Netzausbaupläne (§ 14d Abs. 1 EnWG); quarterly BNetzA BBPlG/EnLAG progress monitoring.

consolidated_republication.note: BNetzA consolidates transmission BBPlG/EnLAG line sections on netzausbau.de, the four TSOs list NEP measures on netzentwicklungsplan.de and BSH publishes offshore designations on gdi.bsh.de. VNBdigital links to distribution plans by operator and lists 95 active plan services.

checked_pages.saw: Confirmed BNetzA collects TSO and permitting-authority transmission data in DANA (login-restricted at dana.netzausbau.de) and republishes BBPlG/EnLAG maps and quarterly Monitoringberichte, excluding distribution grids.
Confirmed SMARD provides market time series and editorial summaries on grid expansion, not a downloadable project/substation inventory.

checked_pages.organization: VNB digital GmbH (Gemeinsame Internetplattform nach § 14e EnWG)
checked_pages.saw: Verified GraphQL catalog of 814 DSOs (95 with active NAP service) serving per-operator 2024 PDFs and 2026 XLSX/PDF files without a merged national file or coordinates.
Ministry policy dossier refers to BNetzA's netzausbau.de, NEP and BBPlG; hosts no separate consolidated GIS or distribution dataset.

national_registry.note: No single national registry covers planned lines and substations across transmission and distribution. Transmission is split between BNetzA's netzausbau.de, the TSOs' NEP project library and BSH's offshore FEP 2025. VNBdigital lists 95 active distribution plan services and provides links by operator.

checked_pages.saw: Found quarterly BBPlG/EnLAG monitoring PDFs (2013–2026) and interactive ArcGIS FeatureServer map for statutory transmission lines only.
Found 272 transmission projects in the NEP 2037/2045 (2025) Digitale Projektbibliothek and companion Punktmaßnahmen PDF, without GIS exports or distribution assets.
Found the central § 14e EnWG portal, with 95 active plan services and individual PDF/XLSX examples. There is no merged national table or GIS layer.
CKAN search returned 34 BSH Flächenentwicklungsplan records, 0 records for Netzentwicklungsplan or Bundesbedarfsplan, and no national planned grid inventory.
Registers generation, storage and grid operators, not individual planned power lines or transformer substations.

if_unstructured.summary: To obtain planned onshore substations (missing from BNetzA GIS), exact commissioning windows for transmission sections, or 110 kV line/substation locations missing from VNBdigital XLSX tables, extract NEP Steckbriefe and Punktmaßnahmen PDFs, netzausbau.de project sheets, DSO Netzausbauplan PDFs, and state permitting dossiers on UVP-Verbund.
recipe: Start with BNetzA Monitoring_gdb (transmission lines) and VNBdigital 2026 Maßnahmenplan XLSX files (distribution lines and substations) to build the structured backbone.

Attach missing transmission commissioning years and HVDC converter status by fetching https://www.netzausbau.de/Vorhaben/ansicht/de.html?nummer=<N>&gruppe=bbplg (table 'Steckbrief' -> 'Gesamtinbetriebnahme' and section accordions) and matching 'BBP-Nr' against NEP 2037/2045 Projektsteckbriefe ('Geplante Inbetriebnahme').

Extract all 871 planned transmission substation, switchgear and 380/110-kV transformer upgrades from NEP_2037_2045_V2025_2_Entwurf_Punktmassnahmen.pdf (pages 4–40) with pdftotext -layout, splitting the two side-by-side column blocks in Tabelle 1 (Startnetz, pp. 4–27) and reading single-width scenario rows in Tabelle 2 (Zubaunetz, pp. 28–40).

For 110 kV lines and HS/MS substations listed without coordinates in VNBdigital XLSX tables, inspect Anhang 1/2 schematic Netzkarten in the DSO's NAP 2026 PDF (e.g. Bayernwerk Netz GmbH pp. 7–8) and search uvp-verbund.de or state Planfeststellungsbehörden portals once 'Stand Genehmigungsverfahren' enters 'im Verfahren'.

UVP-Verbund (uvp-verbund.de) and Bezirksregierungen / Regierungspräsidien / Landesämter Planfeststellung portals for 110 kV and Landesbehörden-led 380 kV alignments
